nexus.agent.allowedCommands.description: Commands an agent may run in its worktree without asking, matched exactly (for example "npm test"). Everything else needs a human approval. User settings only: a repository's workspace settings cannot add to it.

nexus.slack.auth0Connection.description: The Auth0 connection that links Slack, used to get your Slack token from Auth0 Token Vault. User settings only.

nexus.t0.description: The hackathon's start time (ISO 8601, for example 2026-11-06T22:00:00-05:00), used for T+ times.
